title: No usable GPU; running on CPU
message: No usable GPU was found; running on the CPU.
basic_text: Rastai didn't find a graphics card it can use, so it runs on the processor. That is slower.

title: A detection tool failed or timed out; profile is partial
message: {tool} failed or timed out; the hardware profile is partial.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't check all of this computer's hardware.

title: Hardware or environment command not available yet
message: {command_id} isn't available in this version of Rastai yet.
basic_text: This feature is planned but not built yet in this version of Rastai.
fix_text: Nothing to fix on your side: the feature arrives in a later version.

title: Numerical self-test mismatch against the CPU reference; GPU not used
message: GPU {gpu_index} gave results that differ from the CPU reference ({detail}); it is not used.
basic_text: This GPU failed Rastai's safety check, so Rastai won't use it.
fix_text: Update the GPU driver, then run the hardware check again.

title: Self-test could not run a kernel
message: The self-test could not run {kernel} on GPU {gpu_index}.
basic_text: This GPU failed Rastai's safety check, so Rastai won't use it.
fix_text: Update the GPU driver, then run the hardware check again.

title: Self-test exceeded its time budget
message: The self-test on GPU {gpu_index} took longer than {budget_seconds} seconds.
basic_text: This GPU failed Rastai's safety check, so Rastai won't use it.
fix_text: Close other programs using the GPU, then run the hardware check again.

title: Self-test: decode graph capture failed on this GPU; eager decode used there
message: Decode graph capture failed on GPU {gpu_index}; eager decode is used there.
basic_text: This GPU works, but chat on it will be a little slower.

title: uv missing or its hash is wrong
message: uv at {path} is missing or its hash is wrong.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't set up the Python environment it needs to run this.

title: Environment lockfile can't be installed on this platform
message: The {environment} environment's lockfile can't be installed on {platform}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't set up the Python environment it needs to run this.
fix_text: Pick another backend for this computer.

title: Environment import check failed
message: The {environment} environment failed its import check: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't set up the Python environment it needs to run this.

title: Environment sync failed
message: Syncing the {environment} environment failed: {reason}.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't set up the Python environment it needs to run this.
fix_text: Check your connection, then install the environment again.

title: A package's hash doesn't match the lockfile
message: The package {package} doesn't match the hash in the lockfile.
basic_text: A downloaded package didn't pass its security check.

title: Environment not installed or incomplete
message: The {environment} environment is not installed or is incomplete.
basic_text: Rastai couldn't set up the Python environment it needs to run this.

title: Not enough GPU memory for this lease
message: GPU {gpu_index} has {free_bytes} bytes free but this needs {needed_bytes}; held by {holders}.
basic_text: The graphics card doesn't have enough free memory for this.
fix_text: Unload a model or stop another task, then try again.

title: Model is being evicted; generation stopped
message: {model_name} is being unloaded to free GPU memory; generation stopped.
basic_text: The model was unloaded to make room for another task.

title: Process uses more GPU memory than its lease
message: Job {job_id} uses {used_bytes} bytes of GPU memory, more than its lease of {lease_bytes}.
basic_text: A task is using more graphics memory than it asked for.

title: Out of GPU memory while loading
message: Out of GPU memory while loading {model_name}.
basic_text: The graphics card ran out of memory while loading the model.
fix_text: Unload other models, or use a smaller or quantized model.

title: Out of GPU memory inside a job step
message: Out of GPU memory during {operation}.
basic_text: The graphics card ran out of memory.
fix_text: Use a smaller batch or model, or stop other tasks on this GPU.

title: NVIDIA driver too old for CUDA 13; using cuda126
message: NVIDIA driver {driver_version} is too old for CUDA 13; using the cuda126 environment.
basic_text: Your graphics driver is a bit old, so Rastai uses an older GPU toolkit.
fix_text: Update the NVIDIA driver for the newest toolkit.

title: HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION removed from a job
message: HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION was removed from job {job_id}.
basic_text: Rastai removed a risky AMD override setting from this task.

title: No permission to use the AMD GPU
message: No permission to use the AMD GPU; the user isn't in the render and video groups.
basic_text: Your user isn't allowed to use the graphics card.
fix_text: Add your user to the render and video groups, then log in again.

title: GPU architecture not supported by this backend; GPU not used
message: GPU {gpu_index} ({architecture}) isn't supported by the {backend} backend; it is not used.
basic_text: This graphics card isn't supported, so Rastai won't use it.
